September 10, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-10-1971-54683

Martial court orders 145 Awami League MPA to appear before it for allegation of sedition, armoury looting, distributing of unauthorized weapons, giving military training to anti-state people etc.

Lt General Niazi visits Gazipur weapon factory. He thanks the workers for readying the first shipment. He says: “These weapons will be used against the enemy of the state.”

The CMLA reconstructs military rule No. 21 and enacts No. 24.
